name: Željana Zovko - § 26 - Am 4
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement establishing an association between the European Union and the Principality of Andorra and the Republic of San Marino respectively
part_text: 26. Considers it important to offer administrative and technical assistance to Andorra and San Marino, considering also their limited administrative resources, in order to support swift alignment with the current EU *acquis* and with a view to dynamic regulatory alignment and the effective implementation and enforcement of the Association Agreement; encourages Andorra and San Marino to proactively engage in this process, as alignment enhances transparency, fosters competition and improves business efficiency, ultimately reinforcing market integration; draws attention to the fact that such EU technical assistance represents yet another cost to the EU budget, with little to no equivalent benefit returned to EU citizens;
